units.source_text: 老闆娘說這種藥比酒的危害小，我也就聽信了她的話，

en.t: The proprietress said this medicine was less harmful than alcohol, and I believed her,

units.source_text: 況且當時我正好也覺得酗酒很不道德，

en.t: and besides, at the time I had just begun to feel that heavy drinking was terribly immoral,

units.source_text: 能擺脫酒精這個撒旦的長期糾纏也算一種喜悅，

en.t: so there was also a kind of joy in being able to escape the long grip of Satan called alcohol,

units.source_text: 於是毫不猶豫地在自己的手臂上注射了嗎啡，

en.t: and without the slightest hesitation I injected morphine into my own arm,

units.source_text: 把不安、焦慮、害臊全部清除乾淨，我一下子變成一個開朗的雄辯家。

en.t: sweeping away all my unease, anxiety, and shyness, and at once I became a cheerful and eloquent man.

units.source_text: 而且，每當注射完嗎啡，我便忘記身體的虛弱，

en.t: Moreover, whenever I had injected the morphine, I forgot the weakness of my body,

units.source_text: 專注於自己的漫畫工作，常常是畫著畫，就浮現出妙趣橫生的聯想。

en.t: threw myself into my cartoon work, and often, as I drew, wonderfully amusing ideas would come to me.

units.source_text: 本來是一天注射一針，漸漸變成兩針，

en.t: At first it was supposed to be one injection a day, but gradually it became two,

units.source_text: 最後增加到一天四針時，一旦缺了它，我便無法正常工作。

en.t: and by the time it had finally increased to four a day, I could no longer work properly without it.
